Source context

Archive record: this English passage is associated with De Officiis I.22, within the Stoicism tradition. Use the cited work or edition when a scholarly attribution is needed.

A short reading

Read in the register of morality, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Cicero's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
